results.title: Our Team | Cedarline Capital
results.text:
Cedarline Capital
Team

Talia Brennan is Chief of Staff at Cedarline Capital, where she runs the firm's operating cadence, LP reporting, and platform hiring. She joined in 2024 from Halden Growth, where she led business operations.

Omar Vestergaard, Senior Associate, invests in seed and Series A infrastructure software. Before Cedarline he was a founding engineer at Palmetto Loop.

Rosalind Achebe is a General Partner and co-founded the firm in 2016.

San Mateo, California

Wexford Peak Partners
People

Declan Moriyama joined Wexford Peak Partners in 2023 as Principal on the growth team after six years operating at Northbound Freight, most recently as VP of Business Operations.

Ingrid Solheim supports the investment team. Her LinkedIn profile is https://www.linkedin.com/in/ingrid-solheim-wexford and she previously worked at Lakebridge Ventures.

Boston, Massachusetts
